info.name: Search for stations, shows, and podcasts

params.name: query
params.description: Search term. Must be URL-encoded (e.g. "GitFM" becomes "GitFM", multi-word queries should encode spaces as "+").

params.name: render
params.description: Response format override. Set to "json" to receive JSON instead of the default XML/OPML response.

items.docs: Search the TuneIn directory for radio stations, shows, topics, and podcasts. Returns an OPML (XML) or JSON list of matching results. The query parameter must be URL-encoded. Returns a "No results" outline element when no matches are found.
